import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")


# Extract features from string column f_27
def extract_string_features(df, col="f_27"):
    df = df.copy()

    # Split string into characters
    chars = df[col].str.split("", expand=True)
    # Remove first column (empty string at start)
    chars = chars.drop(columns=[0])
    # Rename columns to char_0, char_1, ..., char_9
    chars.columns = [f"char_{i}" for i in range(10)]

    # Encode each character position using target encoding
    for i in range(10):
        char_col = f"char_{i}"
        if char_col in chars.columns:
            # Create target encoding
            means = train.copy()
            means[char_col] = chars.loc[means.index, char_col]
            means_target = means.groupby(char_col)["target"].mean()

            # Encode train and test
            df[f"char_{i}_enc"] = chars[char_col].map(means_target)
            # Fill NaN for unseen categories in test
            df[f"char_{i}_enc"].fillna(train["target"].mean(), inplace=True)

    # Character counts
    for i in range(10):
        df[f"char_{i}_count"] = df[col].str.count(str(i))

    # Letter counts - encode as binary presence indicators
    letters = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    for letter in letters:
        df[f"letter_{letter}_count"] = df[col].str.count(letter)

    # String statistics
    df["str_len"] = df[col].str.len()
    df["unique_chars"] = df[col].apply(lambda x: len(set(x)))
    df["unique_ratio"] = df["unique_chars"] / df["str_len"]

    # First and last character - encode with target encoding
    df["first_char"] = df[col].str[0]
    df["last_char"] = df[col].str[-1]

    return df


# Apply string feature extraction
train = extract_string_features(train)
test = extract_string_features(test)

# Create interaction features for continuous columns
continuous_cols = [
    "f_00",
    "f_01",
    "f_02",
    "f_03",
    "f_04",
    "f_05",
    "f_06",
    "f_19",
    "f_20",
    "f_21",
    "f_22",
    "f_23",
    "f_24",
    "f_25",
    "f_26",
    "f_28",
]

# Create top interaction pairs based on correlation exploration
interaction_pairs = [
    ("f_02", "f_21"),
    ("f_05", "f_25"),
    ("f_00", "f_06"),
    ("f_21", "f_26"),
    ("f_01", "f_20"),
    ("f_03", "f_22"),
    ("f_28", "f_21"),
    ("f_05", "f_21"),
    ("f_00", "f_21"),
]

for col1, col2 in interaction_pairs:
    if col1 in train.columns and col2 in train.columns:
        train[f"{col1}_x_{col2}"] = train[col1] * train[col2]
        test[f"{col1}_x_{col2}"] = test[col1] * test[col2]

# Identify categorical columns to encode
cat_cols = ["f_29", "f_30"]

# Get all feature columns (excluding id and target)
feature_cols = [
    col
    for col in train.columns
    if col not in ["id", "target"]
    and train[col].dtype in ["int64", "int32", "float64", "float32"]
]

# Encode remaining categorical columns using target encoding
for col in cat_cols:
    if col in train.columns:
        # Create target encoding from training data
        means = train.groupby(col)["target"].mean()
        train[col + "_enc"] = train[col].map(means)
        test[col + "_enc"] = test[col].map(means)
        # Fill NaN for unseen categories in test
        test[col + "_enc"].fillna(train["target"].mean(), inplace=True)
        feature_cols.append(col + "_enc")

# Prepare feature sets
X = train[feature_cols].copy()
y = train["target"].copy()
X_test = test[feature_cols].copy()

# Ensure all features are numeric
X = X.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
X_test = X_test.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
X.fillna(0, inplace=True)
X_test.fillna(0, inplace=True)

# Split for validation (stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Create LightGBM dataset
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Train model with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission
submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission["target"] = test_pred
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to submission.csv")
